text: A set of vectors is orthonormal when:
choices: the vectors are pairwise orthogonal and each has norm 1
the vectors are linearly independent and span the space
every pair of vectors has inner product 1
explanation: Orthonormal means ⟨eᵢ, eⱼ⟩ = δᵢⱼ: orthogonality between distinct vectors plus unit length. Orthonormal sets are automatically linearly independent, but need not span.
